note: Quantities the manuscript states that appear inside no reports/ file. The disclosed test count is one: it is measured, not looked up, and it went stale once already -- the manuscript said thirty-three while a bare clone ran forty-seven. Since the frozen-matrix-v2 revision it is measured from a `git archive` extract of the release commit, which is what the Zenodo deposit contains, rather than from a clone. tests/test_reported_numbers.py compares the manuscript against this file.
